completed_foundations.verified_from: GitHub issue state and acceptance checklist

ordering_rule: Dependencies first; P0 before P1 among ready issues; original creation order for ties.

execution.requested: A separate Codex session for each issue, followed by verified commits and upload.
execution.note: session_id remains null because independent Codex conversation creation is unavailable. execution_status, commits and verification record actual work.
execution.mode: Strictly sequential: implement one issue, verify exact commit, merge its PR into main, close the issue, then start the next.
execution.pause_reason: User requested stopping after events #1 PR merge and closure.
